raw_segments.text: Juliet, what devil art thou that dost torment me thus?
This torture should be roared in dismal hell.
Say thou but I, and that bare vowel I shall poison more than the death-darting eye of
I am not I if there be such an eye, or those eyes shut that make the answer I.
If ye be slain, say I, or if not no.
Brief sounds determine of my wheel or woe.
